tracks.title: Pipeline Phases
tracks.subtitle: Tackle each step of the pipeline systematically.

summaries.04_phase_1_understand_problem: Read the brief, inventory the data, pick the metric — the 5% of project time that determines the other 95%.
summaries.05_phase_2_data_exploration_cleaning: EDA, cleaning, feature engineering — the longest, highest-leverage phase. 40% of project time.
summaries.06_phase_3_feature_selection_preprocessi: Narrow the features, transform each column, split into train/test — in the right order.
summaries.07_phase_4_model_selection_training: Baseline, bake-off, model selection, imbalance handling, target transformation — the biggest chapter.
summaries.08_phase_5_optimization: Hyperparameter tuning + ensembling. The phase beginners over-invest in.
summaries.09_phase_6_evaluation_validation: Final test evaluation, threshold tuning, calibration, explainability, fairness audit.
summaries.10_phase_7_deployment: Persist artefacts; address the 8 production concerns. Model isn't done until it's been observed in production.
